## History

Katie Maurice was created by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) as an imaginary friend, envisioned as a little girl who lived inside the reflection of a bookcase door. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) used to pretend to interact with her during her earlier childhood.

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--katie-maurice.md)

Katie Maurice is [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's imaginary bosom friend, invented to serve as a comforting companion. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) confides in Katie as a trusted confidante through her own imagination, creating an idealized bond where none existed in reality. The relationship exists entirely within Anne's mind, acting as a crucial emotional outlet for her.

- Friend of — imaginary bosom friend  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P43](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0043), [v1 CHAPTER VIII.
